translation.question: Ni tukio gani linalohusisha njia muhimu ya usambazaji umeme wa msongo mkubwa wa kV 500 lililosababisha kukatika kwa umeme nchini Chile mwaka 2025?
answer_aliases: kukatwa kwa njia ya usambazaji umeme ya kV 500
translation.translation_note: Translated 'disconnection' as 'kukatwa' (cutting/disconnection) which is standard for power lines in Swahili.

backtranslation_en.question: What event involving a critical 500 kV high-voltage power transmission line caused a power outage in Chile in 2025?
answer_aliases: cutting of the 500 kV power transmission line
